title: Release tool: sign with a key held on a hardware security key
spec: release sign --manifest M --signer P --public H --out S runs P with M's path as its only argument (terminal input and error output passed through, so a device can ask for its PIN or a touch), takes what it prints on standard output as the signature (64 raw bytes, or 128 hex characters with surrounding white space), refuses an invalid manifest, a signer that fails or prints anything else, and a signature that does not verify with open_release against H, and writes the 64 bytes to a new file only. --signer needs --public and cannot be combined with --key. release public --pem F prints the 64-hex-character public key in an Ed25519 SubjectPublicKeyInfo PEM (BEGIN PUBLIC KEY; LF or CRLF line ends) and refuses other PEM types, invalid base64 and other algorithms. release public takes --key or --pem, not both.
